title: Chapter 70 Enemies Of The World Alliance
content:
Chapter 70 Enemies Of The World Alliance

In this way, three groups of people went to the three human remains.

There is a reason why Lu Xue went to the Human Emperor Palace this time.

Since the ruins of the Human Emperor Palace appeared, Xuanyuan Sword has been impatient and uneasy, and has an inexplicable attraction to the Human Emperor Palace.

Seeing this, Lu Xue also understood the meaning of Xuanyuan Sword.

Although this sword was given to her by Lu Daosheng at will, this sword is extremely spiritual and Lu Xue likes it very much.

So it is natural to take Xuanyuan Sword to the Human Emperor Hall.

At the same time, countless creatures with sufficient strength in the world of the Spirits are also heading towards the remains of the three human races.

There is a very likely presence of a stunning treasure in that ruin.

If you leave, you will be lucky.

In a certain space in the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng is here. At this time, there were countless light balls in front of Lu Daosheng, and each light ball was filled with pictures of his subordinates.

The largest one is Lu Xue.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly frowned slightly and then looked up.

Outside the world of all spirits.

Three figures were slowly walking towards here.

Every figure's breath is extremely terrifying.

This is a powerful man who has never appeared in the world of all spirits.

A strong man in the realm of the gods.

Existence above the Botian Realm!

"Captain, there is the world of all spirits ahead."

One of the figures spoke.

Hearing this, the leader nodded.

"The world of all spirits really doesn't know what it means. He dares to reject our world alliance. He didn't destroy them all this time, and this time he will definitely kill them all!"

However, as soon as the words were finished, a voice sounded from the field.

"Do you have to kill them all?"

Hearing this, the three of them were stunned.

The next moment, a figure appeared in front of the three of them.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the three of them with a cold look, and he was a little angry.

This World Alliance is a bit ungrateful.

Do you really think you have a good temper?

When they saw Lu Daosheng, the three of them frowned, and the leader said coldly: "Who are you? Do you dare to protect this world of all spirits, and seek death?"

Seeing his attitude, Lu Daosheng shook his head and waved his hand.

The man disappeared directly.

On the side, the other two were completely confused.

Because in their perception, the captain is dead.

Suddenly, a strong sense of fear filled the hearts of the two.

"You, you, we are from the Realm Alliance, how dare you kill us?"

One of them said in a trembling voice when he looked at Lu Dao.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng sneered, "I have killed one, do you still care about the second one?"

Besides, even the leaders of the World Alliance dare to fight, and he still cares about these little people who can't get on the table?

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, the two of them immediately collapsed on the ground.

They regretted it very much at this moment, why did they take this job?

I thought it was easy, after all, there were almost no strong people in the Breaking Air Realm in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm. Isn’t it possible for them to capture the three powerful people in the God Realm to take action?

But in the end, I encountered such a terrifying strong man.

laugh!

With Lu Daosheng's casual finger, another person disappeared from the spot.

Suddenly, the last one was left in the three people from the Realm Alliance.

At this time, the last man had already turned pale and his whole body was trembling.

"Give me your life, let me go!"

Seeing him begging for mercy, Lu Daosheng slowly said, "Do you want to live?"

"Isn't this nonsense?"

"Um?"

Lu Daosheng immediately glared at him.

The man also quickly reacted and hurriedly said, "I want to live, please spare my life, senior!"

I thought I was dead, but I didn't expect there would be a turning point.

Looking at the person in front of him coldly, Lu Daosheng said coldly: "Tell me, where is the enemy you want to get rid of the most in the Realm Alliance?"

Hearing this, the allied person was stunned.

The enemy you want to get rid of the most.

After a moment of silence, he immediately looked at Lu Daosheng carefully.

What I want to get rid of the most now is you.

And Lu Daosheng seemed to see through the thoughts of the people in this world alliance, and suddenly he was angry and wanted to laugh.

"Do you want to live?"

An invisible force suddenly enveloped the allied person.

As long as his next sentence does not satisfy Lu Daosheng, he can say goodbye to this beautiful world.

"I, I say, I say!"

"Yes, it's the sacred mountain!"

The sacred mountain.

At present, the enemy that the World Alliance wants to solve most is not underestimated, but the strength of the sacred mountain cannot be underestimated. Although it is not as strong as that of the World Alliance, it is difficult to take down the sacred mountain at present.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng did not hesitate and said directly: "Take me to the sacred mountain."

"ah?"

In the end, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but beat the man up.

Three people, I would have known that I would have left one with a smarter one.

Finally, under the leadership of the allied person, Lu Daosheng successfully arrived in front of the sacred mountain.

I saw a super huge mountain standing in the starry sky, and a sacred aura came from the top of the mountain.

After looking at Shenshan, Lu Daosheng nodded.

The strength is indeed pretty good.

Then Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at the allied person with a bruised nose and swollen face, and said, "You can leave now."

Hearing this, his face suddenly turned happy.

"Thank you for your spare time!"

Then he left here as if he was running away.

Just after he left, several cultivators with powerful aura appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Sniffing the surrounding atmosphere, the leader immediately said in a cold voice: "Are you from the Jiemeng?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

"I am not."

"Hmph, you still want to quibble, sneaking to my sacred mountain, looking for death!"

Immediately, the cultivators who looked like guards directly attacked Lu Daosheng.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng was speechless.

He then waved his hand, and the entire void froze.

The next moment, a faint breath slowly overflowed from his body.

In an instant, the entire starry sky directly collapsed inch by inch.

It couldn't bear his breath at all!

After a moment of silence, a figure with a breath that was countless times stronger than those guards in front of him appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

It was an old man in a Taoist robe.

At this time, the old man looked at Lu Daosheng with a solemn expression.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng waved his hand again, and the void recovered again.

The guards also reacted and retreated in succession, with terrified eyes.

"You retreat."

The old man said.

"Yes, Mountain Master."

Mountain Master.

Lu Daosheng looked at the old man in front of him.

Is this the master of this sacred mountain?

The peak of the Divine King Realm is not bad.

"Sir, do you have something to do in my sacred mountain?"

At this time, the old man looked at Lu Daosheng and said in a deep voice.

Although he could not judge the aura just now, it was definitely a strong man above himself.

At this time, the old man guessed that the person in front of him was very likely the strong man in the Divine King Realm.

If the other party came to cause trouble, then their sacred mountain would be in great trouble.

Hearing the old man's words, Lu Daosheng smiled lightly and said, "I heard that you are the enemy of the Realm Alliance?"

Hearing this, the old man narrowed his eyes.

"Are you from the Realm Alliance?"

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Seeing this, the old man breathed a sigh of relief.

It's good that it's not, otherwise, he can only ask for help.

After all, who doesn't have a strong backer in this star field?

At this time, Lu Daosheng slowly told his purpose.

"The Jiemeng is also my enemy. As the saying goes, the enemy of my enemy is my friend, so I am here to help your Shenshan."

Hearing this, the old man was stunned.

Help their Shenshan.

The old man looked at Lu Daosheng suspiciously.

A strong man stronger than himself came to say this to him, and the old man immediately fell into deep thought.

However, at this time, Lu Daosheng interrupted his thinking.

I saw Lu Daosheng directly took out a shit-yellow pill, which also exuded a strong breath.
